description: Delete the rows matching a SQL predicate, e.g. "status = 'spam'". Returns how many rows matched and were removed. Check the predicate first with infino_count or infino_sql. Requires durable storage (not memory://).

predicate.description: SQL predicate selecting the rows to delete, e.g. "status = 'spam'".

name: infino_delete_documents
title: Delete documents from an Infino table
